name: Sacrifice For Sale
source:
Sacrifice For Sale is a spooky Visual Novel in which you try to convince cultists not to sacrifice you.

Choose to respond to what the characters have to say… directly! Deal with your own hostage situation, negotiate for more than just your freedom. Learn about the people who hold you captive, deconstruct the cult, manipulate them- all to not end up as their next sacrifice.

Learn the value of silence! You will never speak a word unless you actively choose to. The entire game can be played as a silent protagonist. Let others speak without interrupting them, give meaningful silent looks and get caught up in your own inner dialogue to reveal new options. Or you could always give in to apathy, accept your faith and be willingly sacrificed!

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2809090/Sacrifice_For_Sale/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《Sacrifice for Sale》是一部气氛阴森的视觉小说。你得说服一群邪教徒，别拿你当祭品。

角色说到哪儿，你就可以直接针对那句话作出回应！你得亲自应付这场绑架，和他们谈条件，能争取的可不只是自由。了解囚禁你的人，瓦解他们的教团，甚至反过来操纵他们——想尽一切办法，别让自己成了下一个祭品。

沉默也自有分量。除非你主动选择开口，否则主角一句话也不会说，你甚至可以沉默着玩完整个故事。别打断别人，静静听他们说下去，投去意味深长的一瞥，或沉入自己的内心独白，都可能打开新的选项。当然，你也可以选择什么都不管，认命，心甘情愿地被献祭！

（整理自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2809090/Sacrifice_For_Sale/]Steam[/url]）
